svg.text: Typical station: pallet transfer station (item 1) – frame, guides, drive, sensors, end stops (side view, schematic)
Chains UP (transfer height 1104 mm), AGV docked on the right. Broken view: 480–780 mm not shown. Numbers = shopping list positions §37.
